text: I think you'll really enjoy the Go-Go Garlic Bread recipe! It's a quick and delicious option that fits within your 30-minute time budget. As a pasta and cheese lover, you'll appreciate the flavorful combination of parmesan and monterey jack cheese in this recipe. Since you don't have any dietary constraints related to gluten, you can easily make this recipe. I've also checked that it doesn't include any mushrooms, so you can feel confident trying this out. Give it a go and I hope you'll love it!
